note: agent-decomposed 2026-09-22 (stasis round 3). A principle/pattern doc: §8 says it introduces no data entity, table, route or entry type — a 'reading' of the kinship-lineage primitives. Buildable residue is the offline floor (binding snapshot), the REA feedback leg, reach-graded declared heads (the same primitive as lens-version-DAG binds-policy), and the specimen resolution. brit-epr does not depend on eprfs-core yet, so the BritCid/BlobCid specimen is not resolved in code (the consolidation spec is still Draft).

items.text: Floor: binding snapshot (declared head + provenance) carried in the artifact, checkable offline — like the governance backref
Mapping 2/5: reach-graded declared-head binding (household binds A, community binds B) over the existing versioned-entity HEAD + Mishpat commitment
items.note: same substrate as lens-version-DAG V1 binds-policy — build once.

items.text: Mapping 4: every invocation through a binding emits a REA feedback leg against the EprRef; renegotiation triggered from evidence
Specimen: resolve BritCid vs BlobCid as a declared head (eprfs-core BlobCid as shared derivation owner; tag-42 vs text-string wire forms deliberately not unified)
